tldr: Black Moon Lilith conjunct the Ascendant.
body: The disowned, uncompromising self sits right on the face you show the world; people feel your raw, untamed edge before you say a word.
business: An undeniable, magnetic presence that refuses to perform.
shadow: A guarded or confrontational first impression, either over-projecting the raw self or hiding it behind armor.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
